Amazon faces class action over alleged discrimination against pregnant workers

Amazon is facing a class-action lawsuit in the United States alleging widespread discrimination against pregnant employees. The lawsuit claims that the company failed to provide reasonable accommodations for pregnant workers, leading to their termination or demotion. The suit seeks damages for affected employees and an injunction to prevent future discrimination. Amazon has not yet publicly responded to the lawsuit.
